Class AlgoEventLog

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.entities.BaseID<Integer>
grafiosch.entities.TenantBaseID
grafioschtrader.entities.AlgoEventLog
@Entity public class AlgoEventLog extends TenantBaseID
Audit trail of a historical replay. The rows are pure system output of a simulation and are therefore deleted with their environment and with the account, but never written to a personal data export: the target instance restores them by running the simulation again.
